summary: NatWest Group plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the appointment of Erminia (Ernie) Johannson as an independent non-executive director effective July 1, 2026. No terms, price, premium, or dates are disclosed; it is a routine board addition. The filing does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, activist campaign, or strategic review. As a foreign private issuer report on a director change, it is classified as 'Other' with medium confidence given the non-routine nature of the filing type.
